title: Human-agent discovery of reconfigurable in-plane ferroelectric superdomain control
abstract: arXiv:2609.06887v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated experimentation is most effective when the observables, available actions, and objective are defined before the experiment starts, as is the case for Bayesian optimization. However, in many exploratory experiments, the variables that describe the sample must be extracted from the data, new operations emerge during the experiments, and the instrument budget is too small to learn the problem by trials. Here we introduce the Scanning Probe Agentic Research Cycle (SPARC) framework, in which a coding agent and a human operator share one microscope, one notebook, and two persistent memory files. FINDINGS.md stores graded conclusions about the experiment, whereas PITFALLS.md records learned failure modes of analysis and instrument. We apply SPARC to reconfigure the in-plane superdomain direction of a (111)-oriented PbZr0.2Ti0.8O3 film. In an operator-supervised campaign, the agent reanalyzed earlier manual measurements and developed

translated_title: 人机协同发现可重构的面内铁电超畴控制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.06887v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：当观测量、可用动作和目标在实验开始前就已确定时（如贝叶斯优化的情况），自动化实验最为有效。然而，在许多探索性实验中，描述样品的变量必须从数据中提取，新的操作会在实验过程中涌现，且仪器使用预算太小，无法通过反复试验来学习问题。在此，我们引入扫描探针智能体研究循环（SPARC）框架，其中一个编码智能体和一名人类操作员共享一台显微镜、一个实验记录本和两个持久记忆文件。FINDINGS.md存储关于实验的分级结论，而PITFALLS.md记录分析和仪器使用中已发现的失败模式。我们将SPARC应用于重构(111)取向PbZr0.2Ti0.8O3薄膜的面内超畴方向。在一次操作员监督的实验活动中，智能体重新分析了早期的手动测量数据并开发了……
tldr: 提出SPARC人机协同研究框架，通过编码智能体与人类操作员共享显微镜、实验记录本及存储结论与失败经验的持久记忆文件，实现了(111)取向铁电薄膜面内超畴方向的可重构控制。
en_tdlr: We introduce SPARC, a human-agent research framework in which a coding agent and a human operator share one microscope, one notebook, and persistent memory files, enabling reconfigurable in-plane superdomain control in (111)-oriented ferroelectric thin films.
